what_this_does_not_establish: No influence and no causation. A filing that cites this bill says a registrant lobbied on it for a client; it does not say whom they met, what they asked for, which side they took, or that any member acted on it.

The money shown is everything a positioned member's campaign received from committees in the cycle, not money about this bill. No published crosswalk links an LDA client to an FEC committee, so lobbying and money are shown side by side and never joined.
The Congress of a cited bill number is inferred from the filing period for 7019 of 8111 citations; a filer citing an older bill with the same number is counted here.
Attributed dollars split each filing's reported income or expenses equally across the bills it cites; filings under $5,000 report no amount.
Committee seats come from the current membership file with no start dates; a seat may postdate the referral.
Voting against one's party majority on a roll call is a descriptive fact about that vote, not evidence about why.
LDA coverage is filing years 2025-2026 only (a partial acquisition), so lobbying on earlier Congresses is absent, not zero.
